title: InterPro2GO issue: more specific BP for IPR030254

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Helen,
Thank you very much for flagging this.
IPR030254 represents a domain, so it should only have mapped GO terms specifically associated to this domain, not to other regions of the proteins included in the entry. According to PMID:[18952056](https://sp.swiss-prot.ch/citations/18952056), the core domain of ABC transporters is composed of six transmembrane helices together with an ABC region (that'd be IPR030254 and IPR003439). It says 'core-TAPL, consisting of six transmembrane helices and the NBD, is able to form an active dimeric peptide transport complex'. Thus, I will not keep any of this GO terms (ATP binding and peptide transport0 mapped to this entry. I will instead check the corresponding type=Family entry IPR039421 and add the corresponding ones. The changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
